 Is Kamal Haasan Playing A Vigilante?
 By REDIFF MOVIES 
 November 07, 2026 13:51 IST 
 2 Minutes Read 
 Summarize this -->
 Listen to this article 
 Watch on Rediff TV 
 Share this Article 
 x 
 Kamal Haasan is set to star in Sandiyar , a new film directed by SU Arun Kumar, with its intriguing first-look poster already generating significant anticipation. 
 Photograph: @RKFI/X 
 Key Points
 Kamal Haasan's new film has been announced, with S U Arun Kumar directing.
 The Sandiyar poster shows Kamal Haasan holding a handgun, sparking curiosity about his role.
 Kamal Haasan has announced the title of his new film, Sandiyar .
 The film will be directed by S U Arun Kumar, known for making Chithha and Sethupathi .
 The title was revealed on Friday by Kamal Haasan's production house Raaj Kamal Films International, a day before the actor's 72nd birthday on Saturday.
 The makers also shared the film's first-look poster on social media. It shows Kamal Haasan standing beside a vehicle and leaning through its open window while holding a handgun.
 The poster has created curiosity about the film and the role the actor will play.
 Sandiyar marks the first time Kamal Haasan and S U Arun Kumar are working together.
 Arun Kumar has earned attention for films such as Sethupathi and Chithha , both of which received praise for their storytelling.
 Music will be composed by Anirudh Ravichander while popular action choreographer Anbariv will handle the action sequences.
 Sunil K S will work as the director of photography, C S Balachander will take care of production design, Amritha Ram will design the costumes.
 Sandiyar is produced by Kamal Haasan and R Mahendran under the banners of Raaj Kamal Films International and Turmeric Media.
 Photograph curated by Satish Bodas/Rediff
